originality.rationale: The same six-coordinate criterion and cardinality are not claimed novel for p=2; previously tabulated image sizes in p=2 and p=3 are also prior art. The presently supported contribution is one general characteristic-dependent theorem uniformly valid for every prime and arbitrary finite extensions, proved by a constructive path classification. Existing first-threshold power-width results, root-adjunction work and published p-power lower bounds do not give this universal if-and-only-if or full image polynomial in their inspected relevant sections; implicit antecedents remain a priority risk.
residual_risks: Implicit equivalent statements might occur in unexamined older literature or in sections not conclusively compared; search failure does not establish priority.
The p=2 criterion and polynomial were already available; only the simultaneous uniform all-prime theorem is claimed as the new contribution.
Finite enumeration is illustrative, not proof for unbounded primes or arbitrary fields.
